meaning: Native behavioral baselines and original-suite mapping. Registration is not a passing test; all live acceptance remains R12.

features.liveAcceptance: Schema/consent, old fallbacks and invalid dates have native fixtures; compile and verify original imports/restart under R12.
Atomic native save, missing-primary backup recovery, corrupt-primary preservation and non-clobber import/export have disk fixtures. Runtime/restart checks remain R12.
Bookmark, trash/restore, purge and associated native credential removal; verify saved-state and failure handling.
Background images and texture loading removed at user request. Verify native controls, selection contrast, resizing and DPI in both modes under R12.
Persistent resize/reset and original sidebar shortcut implemented. Native state fixtures preserve workspace; pointer/narrow-layout and restart checks remain R12.

R10 adds stable tab identities, virtual scrolling/reveal, drag reorder, wrapped keyboard navigation and close-all. Native state/shortcut/application tests preserve identities; compiler/live focus and cleanup checks remain R12.
R10 adds bounded five-second notices with fade/dismiss/log mirror, active Connections actions, counts and clock. Queue/lifetime/overflow fixtures added; compiler/live checks remain R12.
Run Windows tests and live password/key/passphrase sessions; no weak crypto fallback.
Confirmation is bound to host/port/fingerprint; changed key on retry is refused.

R1: gated reconnect until worker cleanup, explicit channel EOF/close, X11 startup cleanup and owned AI/Tools SSH process groups with renewable leases. Ten interpreted cleanup fixtures pass in the cached AlmaLinux/Bash 4.4 build environment, including heartbeat read-boundary and malformed-input checks; compiler and live auth/transfer/process-leak checks remain.
SSH+X11/desktop use production separate bulk transport; verify interactive latency during graphics/file transfers.
Live WireGuard SSH/SFTP; malformed configuration and cancellation.

Readline keys, local clipboard/selection and Shift scrollback coexist with AltGr/IME; run focused native key and live shell regressions.
Remote OSC clipboard requests cannot read local clipboard; no duplicate paste.

Four original presets, eleven semantic roles and saved font/geometry/history/classification choices added. Explicit ANSI colours retain precedence; compare original fixtures and restart settings live.

Bash prompt OSC7 follows shell directories; explicit file-pane navigation quotes a user-initiated cd. Split reports and invalid paths have source regressions. Other shells may supply OSC7; escape output never executes commands.
Dual editable paths and canonical directory listings reject stale replies. Check typing, navigation, selected rows and narrow layouts live.

R4 adds a durable four-job queue, bounded recursive plans, OS/pane drops, pause/retry/resume and explicit stage cleanup. Original hashes/host-account-key bindings survive restart; validate real SFTP prefix/conflict fixtures and live reconnect/cancellation.

Local/server menus, Windows properties/security, Unix chmod, no-clobber rename, open-document ancestor protection and quoted path insertion added. Compare read-only file snapshots; run OS/menu/root/link regressions.

Windows associations and Open With run off the UI thread; host-bound working copies/drafts survive restart, external changes are detected and explicit uploads preserve newer external edits. Test KLayout, picker cancellation, reopen/recovery and server conflicts.
Native editor consumes UTF-8/UTF-16/BOM model and preserves bytes/line endings; run round-trip fixtures.
Native consumers use original SFTP revisions/staged save and local conflict checks; verify races, permissions, disconnected/changed host and recovery.
Independent native viewports with Save/Discard/Cancel and parent shutdown deferral; repeated open/close and crash/freeze regression not run.

R5 source implemented: document/window switching, language selection and embedded syntax colouring, line numbers/wrap/font controls, tabs/spaces and auto indentation, case/word/regex/selected-range search with capture replacement, undo/redo, goto line and aligned saved/file comparisons. Compile and run keyboard, encoding and large-file regressions in R12.

R5 source implements local and original-host SSH language services, per-language/host saved explicit server configuration, completion with additional edits, hover/diagnostics, definition navigation and reviewed formatting/multi-file rename. UTF-16, version, overlap, file-size and dirty-target validation precede buffer edits. Windows child cleanup and live server validation remain R12. Resource creation/deletion/rename and snippets are not advertised.
Native lifecycle uses checksummed bundled agent/runtime and production retained-session handshake; live host validation remains.
Original stream/demux/decoder/framebuffer pipeline is used directly; verify colour/stride/frame order and performance.

R6 source preserves physical Windows keypad/sided modifiers/AltGr/Win/menu/Print/Pause, lock flags, repeat, native mouse order and focus/lease release; exact foreground routing excludes injected events and toolbar/other windows. Existing IME path retains agent capability limits. Compile source regressions and verify live keyboard/drag/system shortcuts under R12.

R6 source uses native physical monitor geometry and window placement, mixed DPI/negative origins, full host layouts on every tab/current/all transition, even/protocol-bounded sizes and unplugged-device fallback. Compile and verify host window repositioning, pointer alignment and hotplug under R12.

R6 source adds free/edge dragging, auto-hide, monitor-aware scaling and persisted validated ratios/device with corrupt-file preservation. Compile regressions and verify all four edges, reconnect/restart, resizing/DPI and removed-monitor fallback under R12.
Production clipboard bridge, focus-scoped local polling and actual frame capture wired; live loop/encoding/clipboard checks remain.

R1: cancellation owns bounded launch/partial handshake, rolls back positively identified fresh agents and preserves existing desktops; unclaimed launches expire. Duplicate IDs persist before launch and reopen through Saved desktop tabs; confirmed End removes records. Compile and validate live cancellation/restart/termination.
Existing production Rust agent is retained and included by the native build recipe, which runs its integration tests when the user builds.

The production icon helper, clipboard, software GLX and multiwindow mode remain. Stage 4 runs the real bundled-manager regression; compile/package/live verification remains R12.
Native Credential Manager store/forget and username consent implemented in a separate namespace. Existing production credential import/namespace compatibility remains.
Native DPAPI plus PBKDF2-HMAC-SHA256 master entropy, context binding and zeroization added. Original envelope compatibility and Windows runtime checks remain.
Production bounded asynchronous JSONL logging, rotation and redaction are retained. Native rotation/redaction/export fixtures added; live cross-process/export checks remain R12.

Original provider IDs/endpoints/manual models migrate; all model tiers stay searchable with declared capability metadata. Custom manual models survive renaming, refresh and restart; first-chat provider/workspace restore no longer silently falls back. Windows/provider verification remains.
HTTPS/loopback policy, no redirects, native TLS, endpoint normalization and bounded requests added; run provider fixtures/live checks.
Bounded SSE and model-capped output limits; OpenRouter reasoning and optional NVIDIA NIM thinking parameters are capability/provider-specific. Live provider checks remain.
Transient pre-response retries with budget, timeout and cancellation; run interruption/rate-limit fixtures and verify no action replay.
Bounded native turn loop, correlated tool results and interrupted-history repair; compile and run native tests, then live tools.
Action/message/chat grants consumed by native UI and execution path; revoke on workspace/history changes and never serialize grants.

Windows/SSH scope and revision checks, no local fallback, Windows jobs and R1 leased SSH process-group cleanup implemented. Verify canonical scopes, connection-loss cleanup and races live; deliberately daemonized services need their own stop.
Per-chat provider/model, draft, local workspace, reasoning, tool and token-budget state restore; remote scope requires the matching live connection.
Original transcripts import without executable tool actions; per-chat bounded files, metadata index, lazy restore, older-message reveal, delete/clear and interruption repair are implemented.
Stable capture thumbnail, preview/remove and approved app capture; 1600px/1MiB limits. Verify vision models and fullscreen capture.
Approved list/select connections, open files/folders, panels, terminal text and screen capture; actions use current identities without changing AI workspace.
Strict validated schema/revision install/remove/list wired; executable script included in AI run approval; installation never runs it.

Quoted Windows/SSH scripts, explicit targets, revisions, approval/output/cancel and R1 SSH process-group lease cleanup implemented. Compile/run tests and validate live host cleanup and full manifest compatibility.

Offline recipe checks normalize release versions, locks, fingerprints and failure/resume behavior. Compiler/package acceptance remains R12.

Build kit packages Windows/Linux regression reports and matching catalog hashes, plus a required passing bundled-X11 result, with installer/ZIP runtimes. Offline artifact/failure fixtures pass; real packaging and clean-machine checks remain R12.

Compile and run the registered fixtures with the build kit. Verify log scrolling, cancel/apply, both theme palettes, import/export, application scaling, startup and preserved credentials in the packaged application.
